AdminForm.description:
The administration form the page posts as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`: the same fields,
checks and effect for the no-script table and for a script client.

generation_revision.description: `generation.activeRevision` of the snapshot the form was built from; a changed revision is a 409.

statusRetry.description: Attempts retried because of the response status.

BucketBounds.description:
Upper bounds, in milliseconds, of the cumulative buckets of every [`Histogram`]. The overflow
bucket is `count`.

queueWait.description: Time spent waiting in a pool queue.

expiresAt.description: The leaf expiry as the TLS library prints it, in GMT.

nextActionUnixSeconds.description: When the ACME reconciler next acts on the certificate.

notAfterUnixSeconds.description: The same instant as Unix seconds; absent when the printed form could not be read.

CheckStats.description: Active health checks. The proxy does not record how long a check took.

EvacuationStats.description: What an evacuation did to the requests of a server.

retired.description: Replaced generations that still drain their connections, oldest first.

HealthFailure.description: Why a check, a passive observation or the canary failed.

HealthOverride.description: Operator override of the observed health: `auto` follows the checks.

HealthState.description:
What the active checks observed: `unchecked` when the server has no checks, `unknown` before
the first result.

Histogram.description:
A latency distribution. `buckets[i]` is the cumulative number of observations at or below the
i-th bound of the matching [`BucketBounds`] list; percentiles read from it are bucket upper bounds.

HttpStats.description:
Finished HTTP operations by outcome; absent until the listener has finished one. The proxy keeps no
per-listener status-class counters.

bind.description: The configured bind with its transport: `socket:<address>`, `udp:<address>` or `unix:<path>`.

service.description: The HTTP, forward-proxy or TCP service the listener serves.

upstreamPool.description: The pool a TCP listener relays to.

PassiveStats.description: Ejections driven by what real requests experienced.

failOpenSelections.description: Selections that used an unavailable server because failing open was allowed.

unavailableSelections.description: Selections that found no available server.

ProcessInflight.description: Requests currently waiting for or served by an upstream server.

stuck.description: Requests the watchdog has reported as stuck.

acceptedConnections.description: Connections accepted by the public listeners.

bytesReceived.description: Bytes read from clients by the public listeners.

bytesSent.description: Bytes written to clients by the public listeners.

QueueStats.description:
Requests waiting for server capacity. The proxy bounds the wait by time (`timeoutMs`), not by depth,
so there is no queue capacity.

byClass.description: Waiting requests per queue class; absent for pools without classes.

timeoutMs.description: The configured limit of the wait; absent when the pool has none.

ResponseStats.description: Responses by status class; `none` counts attempts that ended without a response.

inFlightByKind.description: In-flight work by protocol; the key set is open.

RouteStats.description:
A configured HTTP route. The proxy keeps no per-route request counters, so a route carries
configuration plus the two counters it does keep (`rescues`, `poolSelections`).

id.description: `<service>#<index>`: stable while the configuration keeps the route in place.

index.description: Position of the route in its service.

listeners.description: The listeners that serve the service.

pool.description: The pool a `proxy` route sends to.

poolSelections.description: Requests a header selector sent to a pool; same availability as `rescues`.

rescues.description:
Requests replayed after the backend answered a rescue status, by that status. Absent until one was
recorded, and absent when several services have a route at this index, because the proxy keys the
counter by index alone.

status.description: The status of a `fixed_response` or `redirect` route.

address.description: The configured upstream endpoint: socket address, `host:port` or Unix socket path.

available.description: Whether the balancer may pick the server now.

downtimeMs.description: How long the server has been unhealthy; absent while it is not.

ServerStatus.description: The state a person reads first: the server's own judgement of whether it takes traffic.

total.description: Every attempt made on the server, whatever its outcome.

StatsDocument.description: What a client may do: serialised next to the cached snapshot because it depends on who asks.

admin.description:
True when this client may post administrative state changes: a loopback peer of a page with
`admin = "localhost"`. The form then needs `generation.activeRevision`.

intervalHintMs.description: How often a client should poll; never below one second, the server's own refresh floor.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped on any incompatible change of this document.

TrafficStats.description: What the proxy counted for a server, or for a whole pool as the sum over its servers.

WarningStats.description: A valid setting that cannot behave the way it reads.

info.description: Read-only statistics served by a stats page listener. Every client that can reach the listener gets the same snapshot; only `admin` depends on the peer. Keys the proxy does not know are omitted, never zero. Counters are decimal strings, gauges and timestamps are numbers. All responses are `Cache-Control: no-store`; `HEAD` answers like `GET` without a body.
info.title: OxiRoute Stats Page API

503.description: No generation is active or the runtime could not be sampled.

get.summary: The page: a table that needs no script.

post.description: Only for loopback peers of a page configured with `admin = "localhost"` and only when the request is same-origin (loopback `Host`, matching `Origin` or `Referer`, no forwarding headers); `admin` in the snapshot says whether to offer it.

204.description: The state changed; the next snapshot shows it.

403.description: The peer or the request origin may not administer.

404.description: The pool or the server does not exist.

409.description: The generation revision changed since the snapshot.

post.summary: Changes the administrative state of one server.

get.description: Rebuilt at most once per second and shared by every client. Poll no faster than `intervalHintMs`.

503.description: No generation is active or the runtime could not be sampled.

get.description: One header line starting with `# `, then one row per listener, pool and server, under the HAProxy column names for the values the proxy has. Unknown cells are empty. Text cells are quoted when needed and prefixed with `'` when they start with a formula character.

503.description: No generation is active or the runtime could not be sampled.

get.summary: HAProxy-style CSV of listeners (`FRONTEND`), pools (`BACKEND`) and servers.

prefix.description: The `uri_prefix` of the stats page; `/` when it is the root.
